name: Eien no Kajitsu
source:
Main character reunites with his sister for the first time in many years in strange circumstances. Both have lost their memories of old times due to bad luck. In this nostalgic atmosphere they will need to regain their memories

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在奇妙的際遇下，與多年不見的姊姊重逢。兩人都因不幸遭遇失去了往昔記憶。在熟悉又令人懷唸的氛圍裡，他們需要重新找回自己的記憶。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
